<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';
  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger, SplitText);

  /* ============================================================ §0 motorn
     Lenis <-> GSAP wiring per lenis-skillen, ordagrant: autoRaf:false,
     gsap.ticker som enda RAF-drivare, lagSmoothing(500,33), scroll -> ST.update.
     respectReducedMotion:false: rörelse spelar alltid (F-011, spec §0). ----- */
  /* R3 §2 (F-020): husets tempo - lerp:0.075, wheelMultiplier:0.6, det
     enda utjämningslagret (scroll/devices.md § Load-bearing rules). */
  var lenis = new Lenis({ autoRaf: false, anchors: true, respectReducedMotion: false, lerp: 0.075, wheelMultiplier: 0.6 });
  window.__lenis = lenis; /* dev hook: lets §10's jump-test drive lenis.scrollTo(...,{immediate:true}) */
  gsap.ticker.add(function(time){ lenis.raf(time * 1000); });
  gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(500, 33); /* a stalled frame (>500 ms) counts as 33 ms: the scroll pauses and resumes instead of jumping to catch up (lead 2026-09-25) */
  lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update);

  /* R5 fix: a ScrollTrigger.refresh() that lands WHILE the calyx showcase
     iframe is still navigating (its 'load' hasn't fired yet - a live
     same-origin document loading INSIDE an already-pinned element) reliably
     threw "insertBefore ... no longer a child" from ScrollTrigger's own
     pin-revert step, reproduced by bisecting away pin/scrub/onRefresh/the
     iframe itself one at a time until only "pin + a loading iframe inside
     it" remained. fonts.ready and the two setTimeout sweeps below can land
     in that same early window (R3: the per-image load listener that used to
     sit here is gone, see the note by §0's img-refresh removal), so every
     refresh() in the file is routed through this one gate: it
     queues (never drops) until no showcase frame is mid-navigation (R7: framesSettled), then
     also coalesces same-frame calls into one trailing refresh(). */
  var __refreshTimer = null;
  function framesSettled(){
    /* R7 (H12): both frames mount lazily now, so "settled" means no frame is
       between src and load (3 s cap, so a failed load never blocks refresh). */
    var C = window.__CASES;
    if (!C) return true;
    return Object.keys(C).every(function(k){
      var f = C[k].iframe;
      return !f || !f.getAttribute('src') || C[k].loaded || (performance.now() - (C[k].mountedAt || 0) > 3000);
    });
  }
  function safeRefresh(){
    if (!framesSettled()){
      if (__refreshTimer) clearTimeout(__refreshTimer);
      __refreshTimer = setTimeout(safeRefresh, 60);
      return;
    }
    if (__refreshTimer) clearTimeout(__refreshTimer);
    __refreshTimer = setTimeout(function(){ __refreshTimer = null; ScrollTrigger.refresh(); }, 200);
  }

  /* R7: the old data-src sweep matched no element and was removed; the two
     showcase frames mount through an IntersectionObserver in §7. */
  var defer = window.requestIdleCallback
    ? function(fn){ requestIdleCallback(fn, { timeout: 1500 }); }
    : function(fn){ setTimeout(fn, 1); };

  /* ----- refresh trigger: fonts only. R3 §1 (F-021): every <img> on this
     page is either position:absolute;inset:0 (a fill layer inside an
     already-sized cell) or carries explicit width/height, so a load event
     can never change page geometry - the per-image refresh-on-load listener
     this used to have only fired ScrollTrigger.refresh() calls during the
     scroll pass as lazy images entered view (measured: 4 refreshes/pass),
     with nothing to actually remeasure. Removed; fonts.ready still refreshes
     once, since a webfont swap DOES change measured line/text geometry. ----- */
  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready){
    document.fonts.ready.then(function(){ safeRefresh(); }).catch(function(){});
  }

  var isNarrow = window.innerWidth < 768;
  /* R7 (H10): the same two media queries as the CSS. The showcase pins only
     where its side column fits; short viewports get the stacked layout. */
  var PIN_MQ = '(min-width:768px) and (min-height:561px)';
  var STACK_MQ = '(max-width:767px), (max-height:560px)';
  function isPinLayout(){ return window.matchMedia(PIN_MQ).matches; }

  /* ============================================================ §3 dither -> färg
     GSAP grid-stagger (cyphr-studio lån, byggspec §1): each image cell
     gets a tile grid of <span>s cut from the dither image, layered over
     the now fully-visible colour layer. Tiles fade out on a random-order
     schedule scrubbed to the cell's own scroll range, so the resolve reads
     as pixels dissolving away, reversible on scroll-back. Hero cells
     (data-resolve="stay") keep their flat dither look and are excluded,
     per spec §3 ("alla bildceller utom heron"). ----- */
  function buildTileGrid(cell, rows, cols){
    var dither = cell.querySelector('.dither-layer');
    var color = cell.querySelector('.color-layer');
    if (!dither || !color) return null;
    gsap.set(color, { clipPath: 'inset(0px 0px 0px 0px)' });
    var src = dither.getAttribute('src');
    var grid = document.createElement('div');
    grid.className = 'tile-grid';
    grid.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = 'repeat(' + cols + ',1fr)';
    grid.style.gridTemplateRows = 'repeat(' + rows + ',1fr)';
    var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
    var tiles = [];
    for (var r = 0; r < rows; r++){
      for (var c = 0; c < cols; c++){
        var t = document.createElement('span');
        t.style.backgroundImage = 'url(' + src + ')';
        t.style.backgroundSize = (cols * 100) + '% ' + (rows * 100) + '%';
        t.style.backgroundPosition = (cols < 2 ? 0 : (c / (cols - 1) * 100)) + '% ' + (rows < 2 ? 0 : (r / (rows - 1) * 100)) + '%';
        frag.appendChild(t);
        tiles.push(t);
      }
    }
    grid.appendChild(frag);
    cell.appendChild(grid);
    dither.style.visibility = 'hidden';
    return tiles;
  }

  var resolveCells = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.img-cell[data-resolve]'));
  var tileDims = isNarrow ? [6, 6] : [12, 8];
  resolveCells.forEach(function(cell){
    if (cell.getAttribute('data-resolve') === 'stay') return;
    var tiles = buildTileGrid(cell, tileDims[0], tileDims[1]);
    if (!tiles) return;
    gsap.to(tiles, {
      opacity: 0,
      stagger: { grid: tileDims, from: 'random', amount: 0.9 },
      scrollTrigger: {
        trigger: cell, start: 'top 85%', end: 'center 55%',
        scrub: true, invalidateOnRefresh: true,
        /* R7 (H11): will-change only inside the resolve range, never at rest */
        onToggle: function(self){ cell.classList.toggle('is-resolving', self.isActive); }
      }
    });
  });

  /* ============================================================ small helper:
     a colour-matched fill that reveals from an element's left seam via
     clip-path, standing in for "cellens bakgrund fylls från sin skarv"
     wherever the spec asks for it (§4 tes-lines, §7 case heads). Keeps the
     original text above it (z-index) so nothing is ever covered. ----- */
  function seamFill(cell, fromClip){
    var cs = getComputedStyle(cell);
    var bg = cs.backgroundColor;
    if (!bg || bg === 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)') return null;
    var fill = document.createElement('div');
    fill.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    fill.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;background:' + bg + ';clip-path:' + (fromClip || 'inset(0 100% 0 0)') + ';';
    if (getComputedStyle(cell).position === 'static') cell.style.position = 'relative';
    cell.insertBefore(fill, cell.firstChild);
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(cell.children, function(child){
      if (child === fill) return;
      if (getComputedStyle(child).position === 'static') child.style.position = 'relative';
      child.style.zIndex = child.style.zIndex || '1';
    });
    cell.style.background = 'transparent';
    return fill;
  }

  /* R4 fix: SplitText's mask:'…' wrapper clips to a tight box, and the
     headlines here run at line-height:.8-1 - tight enough that a
     descender (g, y, p) gets sliced by that box's own bottom edge. Give
     every mask wrapper a hair of bottom breathing room via padding+
     matching negative margin, so the box grows without shifting layout
     (the negative margin cancels the padding's added height). ----- */
  function maskBreathe(instance){
    if (!instance || !instance.masks) return;
    instance.masks.forEach(function(m){
      m.style.paddingBottom = '0.16em';
      m.style.marginBottom = '-0.16em';
    });
  }

  /* ============================================================ §1 laddning
     · heron sätts ihop (once, <=1.4s). Cellerna öppnas med clip-path FRÅN
     sin skarv (det inre hörnet mot korsningen), inte från kanten: fjärde
     cellen (NH) sist, i diagonal ordning ÖV -> ÖH+NV -> NH. ----- */
  var heroStageEl = document.querySelector('.hero-stage');
  var HERO_SEAMS = [
    { el: document.querySelector('.hero-ov'), from: 'inset(100% 0% 0% 100%)' },
    { el: document.querySelector('.hero-oh'), from: 'inset(100% 100% 0% 0%)' },
    { el: document.querySelector('.hero-nv'), from: 'inset(0% 0% 100% 100%)' },
    { el: document.querySelector('.hero-nh'), from: 'inset(0% 100% 100% 0%)' }
  ];
  HERO_SEAMS.forEach(function(s){ if (s.el) gsap.set(s.el, { clipPath: s.from }); });

  var seamV = document.createElement('div');
  seamV.className = 'seam-line';
  seamV.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  seamV.style.cssText = 'left:50%;top:0;bottom:0;width:1px;transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:50% 0%;';
  var seamH = document.createElement('div');
  seamH.className = 'seam-line';
  seamH.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  seamH.style.cssText = 'top:50%;left:0;right:0;height:1px;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:0% 50%;';
  if (heroStageEl){ heroStageEl.appendChild(seamV); heroStageEl.appendChild(seamH); }

  var h1Split = SplitText.create('.hero-h1', { type: 'lines', mask: 'lines', aria: 'auto' });
  gsap.set(h1Split.lines, { yPercent: 100 });
  maskBreathe(h1Split);

  var cardAnchor = document.getElementById('cardAnchor');
  var cardFlip = document.getElementById('cardFlip');
  gsap.set(cardAnchor, { opacity: 0, y: -48, rotation: -3, transformOrigin: '50% 0%' });

  var loadTl = gsap.timeline({ defaults: { ease: 'power2.out' } });
  loadTl
    .to([seamV, seamH], { scaleX: 1, scaleY: 1, duration: 0.26, ease: 'power1.out' }, 0)
    .to(HERO_SEAMS[0].el, { clipPath: 'inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)', duration: 0.48 }, 0.14)
    .to([HERO_SEAMS[1].el, HERO_SEAMS[2].el], { clipPath: 'inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)', duration: 0.48 }, 0.36)
    .to(HERO_SEAMS[3].el, { clipPath: 'inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)', duration: 0.42 }, 0.58)
    .to(h1Split.lines, { yPercent: 0, duration: 0.7, ease: 'power4.out', stagger: 0.08 }, 0.4)
    .to(cardAnchor, { opacity: 1, y: 0, rotation: 0, duration: 0.55, ease: 'back.out(1.4)' }, 0.75);

  /* ============================================================ §2 heron
     under scroll: pin på desktop (~220% viewport, R3 §2), scrub:true. Ingen
     pin på mobil - kortare, ren scrub-koreografi över hero-wrap:s naturliga
     höjd. */
  /* give the ÖH/NV dither layers overscan headroom before parallaxing them:
     an object-fit:cover image translated by a %-of-own-height can expose
     the cell's own grey fallback background at the opposite edge once it
     moves - scaling up first keeps the cover intact through the full
     +/-8% yPercent range used below. */
  gsap.set('.hero-oh .dither-layer, .hero-nv .dither-layer', { scale: 1.18 });

  var mm = gsap.matchMedia();
  mm.add({ isDesktop: '(min-width:768px)', isMobile: '(max-width:767px)' }, function(context){
    var isDesktop = context.conditions.isDesktop;
    /* R3 §2 (F-020): +=220% (var 120%) så kortvändningen syns hända, inte
       är klar efter första hjulsteget - heroTl:s egna positioner (0..1)
       sprids automatiskt över den längre sträckan. scrub:true överallt
       (var 0.6): Lenis är det enda utjämningslagret. */
    var stCfg = isDesktop
      ? { trigger: '#hero', start: 'top top+=48', end: '+=220%', scrub: true, pin: '.hero-stage', pinSpacing: true }
      : { trigger: '#hero', start: 'top top', end: '+=60%', scrub: true };
    /* R7 (H2): 'top top+=48' pins the stage directly under the 48 px topline,
       so its calc(100svh - 48px) height ends on the viewport edge (the black
       band under it was 48 px). anticipatePin is gone: with Lenis it only
       moved the pin early and counted as layout shift.
       R7 (H5): the card-back CTA takes clicks once the back faces the reader
       (rotationY passes 90 at timeline progress 0.5, power1.inOut). */
    stCfg.onUpdate = stCfg.onRefresh = function(self){
      if (cardAnchor) cardAnchor.classList.toggle('is-back', self.progress > 0.5);
    };
    /* R5 §A: h1 fick förut samma yPercent-drift som kortvändningen (position
       0), vilket kunde skära cellens h1 innan besökaren hunnit läsa den.
       Timeline-positioner nedan är TIDER i en 1-enhets skala (varje .to
       ovan har fått en explicit duration som summerar till 1), så en
       position på 0.75 = sista fjärdedelen av pinnen, exakt när
       kortvändningen (som pågår hela 0..1) är i sitt sista skede. h1 rör
       sig därför bara i den sista fjärdedelen - resten av pinnen (90 av
       120 vh) står den helt stilla och läsbar. */

       still-about:blank document from the instant a new `src` is assigned
       (navigation hasn't swapped contentDocument yet) - a blank document's
       scrollHeight equals its own clientHeight, so max === 0 exactly
       (not negative), which slipped past a `max < 0` guard and produced
       every anchor's clamp collapsing to 0 (all six caseY() reads stuck
       at 0px). Require readyState:'complete' AND max > 0 (a real page's
       content should always exceed the frame height) so the caller's

       "succeeding" against garbage. */

       direkt (page.evaluate, fyra separata sidladdningar av samma calyx.html)
       visade att webbläsarens EGEN scrollTo-klamning konsekvent landar
       9-14px LÄGRE än den beräkningen - en generell webbläsarkvirk
       (subpixel-avrundning mellan layoutets rapporterade scrollHeight och
       vad scrollTo faktiskt tillåter), inte typsnittsladdning (den
       hypotesen testad och motbevisad separat: #commission.offsetTop är
       bevisligen stilla från 150ms efter load).

       Två dyrare fixar försökta och förkastade, båda mätta: (1) fråga
       webbläsaren varje gång (scrolla till ett stort värde, läs, återställ)
       gjorde siffrorna VÄRRE (7/3/28/11px), eftersom measureCase också körs
       medan en pågående tween SKRIVER till samma C.w - "återställ" kolliderade
       med den skrivningen. (2) samma sond men cachead en gång per `ih` slog
       fortfarande fel när cachen råkade sättas mitt i en pågående skrivning.
       Fixen som faktiskt håller, utan sidoeffekter: en fast säkerhetsmarginal
       under den beräknade `max`, ordentligt större än den uppmätta kvirken

  /* R7 runda 2, fynd 4: den verkliga orsaken satt i measureCase() ovan (den

     se den kommentaren. Kvar här: en ren defensiv ommätning när iframens
     egna webbtypsnitt (om sidan har några) hunnit byta in, billig och
     harmlös oavsett om den råkar sakna ett verkligt fel att fånga. */

  function fitSiteWidth(C){
    var f = C.iframe, d = null;
    try { d = f && f.contentDocument; } catch (e) { d = null; }
    if (!d || !d.documentElement) return;

  function measureCaseSettled(C){
    fitSiteWidth(C);

    var d = null;
    try { d = C.iframe && C.iframe.contentDocument; } catch (e) { d = null; }

  /* B: segment k (1..n-1) owns progress [k/n,(k+1)/n) - first half glides
     anchor k-1 -> k with sine.inOut (zero velocity both ends, no jerk),
     second half dwells on anchor k in the reading window. Segment 0 is rest
     on anchor 0. n = C.y.length (each case's own anchor count) - the PIN's
     total pixel length is fixed regardless of n (see setupDesktopEngine),
     this only divides that fixed [0,1] progress range into the case's own
     stops. */
  /* R3 §3 (F-020): sajten glider under de FÖRSTA 70% av segmentet (var 50%)
     och står still resten - mjukare, längre glid innan läsfönstret. */
  var SITE_GLIDE_FRAC = 0.7;
  function caseY(C, p){
    var n = C.y.length, pp = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p)), kf = pp * n;
    var k = Math.min(n - 1, Math.floor(kf)), t = kf - k;
    if (k === 0) return C.y[0];

    var u = 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(Math.PI * half); /* sine.inOut */

  function writeCaseScroll(C, p){

     the crossfade's own 25%/25% timing so the outgoing step is still
     flagged active while it fades and the incoming one only takes over
     once its own fade-in starts (SHOWCASE-SPEC §C: "tonas ut i första 25%",
     "tonas in i nästa 25%"). */
  /* R3 §3 (F-020): texten tonas över under de FÖRSTA 30% av segmentet
     (ut 0-15%, in 15-30%), var 50% (25%/25%) - kortare övertoning, längre
     still-stående läsfönster. */
  var STEP_OUT_FRAC = 0.15, STEP_IN_FRAC = 0.15;
  var RES_START = 0.30, RES_DUR = 0.20; /* figure resolve window, per segment (R6b) */
  function activeStepIndexFor(n, p){

  /* desktop only: toggles aria-hidden/visibility once per step change (not

     is C.tl (built in buildStepTimelines), scrubbed by the same pin. */
  function setStepState(C, p){
    var n = C.anchors.length;
    var idx = activeStepIndexFor(n, p);
    if (C.lastStep === idx) return;
    C.lastStep = idx;
    /* R7 (H6): opacity alone hides the inactive steps (C.tl), so a screen
       reader reaches all of them; no aria-hidden, no visibility:hidden. */
    C.steps.forEach(function(row, i){ row.classList.toggle('is-active', i === idx); });
    if (C.counter) C.counter.textContent = pad2(idx + 1) + ' / ' + pad2(n);
  }

  function writeTrackFill(p){
    var pp = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p));

    });

  /* R7 (H11): a figure's 40 tiles are promoted only around its own resolve
     window; the class flips once per crossing, not per frame. */
  function setFigureResolving(C, p){
    if (!C.figures || !C.figures.length) return;
    var n = C.anchors.length, pad = 0.04 / n;

      var s = (i + (i === 0 ? 0.05 : RES_START)) / n, e = s + RES_DUR / n;
      var on = p >= s - pad && p <= e + pad;
      if (fig.__res !== on){ fig.__res = on; fig.classList.toggle('is-resolving', on); }
    });

  function updateShowcase(C, p){
    writeCaseScroll(C, p);

  /* C: one GSAP timeline per case, paused, progress-driven (never played) -
     0..1 on the timeline maps 1:1 to the pin's own progress. Each step k
     (1..n-1) fades out step k-1 (opacity 1->0, y 0->-12px) over the
     segment's first 25%, then fades in step k (opacity 0->1, y 12->0) over
     the next 25%; the remaining 50% (the segment's dwell half, matching B)
     is untouched, so the step reads fully still for >=40vh. Only opacity
     and transform animate. */
  function buildStepTimelines(){
    Object.keys(CASES).forEach(function(key){
      var C = CASES[key];
      var box = C.el.querySelector('.showcase-rows');
      C.head = C.el.querySelector('.showcase-head');
      C.box = box;
      C.counter = box.querySelector('.showcase-counter');
      C.trackFill = box.querySelector('.showcase-track-fill');
      C.steps = Array.prototype.slice.call(box.querySelectorAll('.showcase-row'));
      C.textEls = C.steps.map(function(row){ return row.querySelector('.showcase-row-text'); });
      var n = C.anchors.length;
      gsap.set(C.textEls, { opacity: 0, y: 12 });
      gsap.set(C.textEls[0], { opacity: 1, y: 0 });
      C.steps.forEach(function(row, i){ row.classList.toggle('is-active', i === 0); });
      C.lastStep = 0;
      /* R6 runda 6 (F-022): detaljcellen - en figur per steg, samma dither->
         färg-rutnät som #kontakt/tes-bilden (buildTileGrid, ingen ny variant).
         Rutnätet byggs en gång här (aldrig i klickvägen) och dess tiles
         tonas i den här casens egen C.tl nedan, i samma skrubbade tidslinje
         som texten - aldrig en egen scrollTrigger (det vore resolveCells
         generiska mekanism, avsedd för fristående bildceller, inte för
         steg som redan drivs av pinnens progress). 8x5 - ungefär kvadratiska
         rutor mot detaljcellens liggande proportion. */
      var TILE_COLS = 8, TILE_ROWS = 5;
      C.detail = box.querySelector('.showcase-detail');
      C.figures = C.detail ? Array.prototype.slice.call(C.detail.querySelectorAll('.showcase-figure')) : [];
      C.figureTiles = C.figures.map(function(fig){ return buildTileGrid(fig, TILE_ROWS, TILE_COLS); });
      gsap.set(C.figures, { opacity: 0 });
      if (C.figures[0]) gsap.set(C.figures[0], { opacity: 1 });
      var tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      for (var k = 1; k < n; k++){
        var segStart = k / n, outDur = STEP_OUT_FRAC / n, inDur = STEP_IN_FRAC / n;
        tl.to(C.textEls[k - 1], { opacity: 0, y: -12, duration: outDur, ease: 'power2.out' }, segStart);
        tl.to(C.textEls[k], { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: inDur, ease: 'power2.out' }, segStart + outDur);
        /* figuren tonas i/ur med samma position/duration som texten - "en
           mekanism", ingen separat timing för bilden. */
        if (C.figures[k - 1]) tl.to(C.figures[k - 1], { opacity: 0, duration: outDur, ease: 'power2.out' }, segStart);
        if (C.figures[k]) tl.to(C.figures[k], { opacity: 1, duration: inDur, ease: 'power2.out' }, segStart + outDur);
      }
      /* R6b (leadens fel 3): dither->färg tar 20 % av segmentet och börjar
         när intoningen är klar (0.30/n), så vilotillståndet 0.50-1.0 plus nästa
         stegs uttoning är ren färg. R6 löste upp rutorna i slumpvis ordning
         över halva segmentet, och varje stillbild mitt i var ett schackbräde
         av raster och färg. Nu går upplösningen som en diagonal våg från
         övre vänstra hörnet: varje ruta tonar på 35 % av fönstret och vågen
         sprids över resten, så en stillbild visar en trappstegskant med färg
         bakom och raster framför, aldrig lösa rutor. Steg 0 har ingen intoning
         att vänta in och löses upp direkt när pinnen börjar. */
      C.figures.forEach(function(fig, i){
        var tiles = C.figureTiles[i];
        if (!tiles || !tiles.length) return;
        var win = RES_DUR / n;

          opacity: 0,
          ease: 'none',
          duration: win * 0.35,
          stagger: { grid: [TILE_ROWS, TILE_COLS], from: 'start', amount: win * 0.65 }

         positions on a 0-1 scale, but the last one ends near 0.86, so the
         timeline was shorter than 1 and tl.progress(p) ran the text out of
         step with the counter and the site - late steps never faded in, and
         scrolling back left the active step at opacity 0. */
      tl.set({}, {}, 1);

  /* A: the pin is created ONCE here, at init, and never killed/recreated -

     The pin's own length is FIXED (6 segments x 75vh) regardless of which
     case is active or how many anchors it has, so a casebyte never needs a
     geometry-changing refresh() (grundorsak 6); Calyx's 5 anchors simply
     divide that same fixed length into 5 stops instead of 6 (see caseY). */

      pin: '.showcase-stage', pinSpacer: '.showcase-pin-spacer', pinSpacing: true, scrub: true,

  function setMobileRowOpacity(textEls, activeIndex){

  function activateCase(key, opts){

       inga layoutläsningar. CDP-tracing runt klicket (RAPPORT.md R5) mätte
       de tre största posterna i den gamla 470-536 ms-bildrutan: Layout
       ~154-164 ms (Hōrais dokument, tvingat av measureCase), Script ~226 ms

           R7 (H7): the frame at opacity 0 is aria-hidden as well as inert.

           it has, instead of an empty white frame. */

        tl.to(prevC.iframe, { opacity: 0, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0);
        if (prevC.poster && prevC.poster.style.display !== 'none') tl.to(prevC.poster, { opacity: 0, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0);
        if (prevC.head && prevC.box) tl.to([prevC.head, prevC.box], { opacity: 0, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0);
        tl.to(C.iframe, { opacity: C.loaded ? 1 : 0, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0);
        if (showPoster) tl.to(C.poster, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0);

          prevC.el.toggleAttribute('inert', true);

          /* R7 (H14): the stacked layout's row triggers are built only now,

             where the rows really are (they were 1 155 px late). Triggers
             below the showcase are re-measured one by one; no global refresh. */
          if (!isPinLayout()){

  function refreshTriggersBelowShowcase(){
    var sc = document.getElementById('showcase');
    if (!sc) return;

      if (sc.compareDocumentPosition(t) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING) st.refresh();

    /* mobile (§C): no pin - the frame sits position:sticky (CSS) while
       rows scroll under it; each row's onEnter/onEnterBack tweens the
       site's own inner scroll to that row's anchor over 0.6s, and
       crossfades the active row's text to opacity 1 / the rest to
       MOBILE_INACTIVE_OPACITY over 0.35s (measured contrast fix, see the
       constant's own comment). R5 bugfix (kept): scaleShowcaseFrame() was
       only ever called from setupDesktopEngine() (the isDesktop branch) -
       on mobile the iframe kept its native 1440x900 box with no scale
       transform at all, so the sticky cell showed an unscaled, cropped
       sliver of the top-left corner instead of the whole page shrunk to fit.

       R7 runda 2, fynd 2 (tredje bugfixen): building triggers for BOTH
       cases' rows here, unconditionally, used to fire onEnter for the
       inactive case's rows immediately at creation - its panel is
       display:none at that point, so getBoundingClientRect() on every one
       of its rows reads {top:0, bottom:0}, which already satisfies
       `start:'top 70%'` the instant ScrollTrigger checks it. Measured
       (page.evaluate, straight after page load, no click/scroll yet):
       CASES.horai.pendingRow was already 5 (the LAST row) before a single
       real scroll happened - all six onEnter calls had already misfired.
       ScrollTrigger then treats that forward crossing as spent and never
       re-fires it on a real scroll in the same direction, so the case
       stayed frozen at whatever that init-time misfire last touched.
       Building only the CURRENTLY VISIBLE case's row triggers - and
       rebuilding them in activateCase() the moment a case becomes visible,
       when its rows have real, live positions - is what actually fixes it. */
    buildMobileRowTriggers(CASES[activeCaseKey]);
    return function(){ mobileTriggers.forEach(function(t){ t.kill(); }); mobileTriggers = []; };
  });

  /* R7 (MED, H14): a row becomes active when its top reaches the frame's
     bottom edge + 16 px + the height of the row above it, and stays active
     until the next row does the same. The active row's heading therefore
     stays below the sticky frame while it is active (at 'top 70%' it slid
     under the frame). onToggle with an endTrigger behaves the same in both
     scroll directions. */
  function buildMobileRowTriggers(C){
    mobileTriggers.forEach(function(t){ t.kill(); });
    mobileTriggers = [];
    var rows = Array.prototype.slice.call(C.el.querySelectorAll('.showcase-row'));
    var textEls = rows.map(function(row){ return row.querySelector('.showcase-row-text'); });
    C.mobileTextEls = textEls;
    gsap.set(textEls, { opacity: MOBILE_INACTIVE_OPACITY });
    gsap.set(textEls[0], { opacity: 1 });
    var cell = document.querySelector('.showcase-embed-cell');
    function line(i){
      var fb = 48 + (cell ? cell.offsetHeight : 0);
      return Math.round(Math.min(window.innerHeight - 130, fb + 16 + rows[Math.max(0, i - 1)].offsetHeight));
    }
    rows.forEach(function(row, i){
      var cfg = {
        trigger: row, invalidateOnRefresh: true,
        start: function(){ return 'top ' + line(i) + 'px'; },
        onToggle: function(self){ if (self.isActive){ tweenCaseTo(C, i); setMobileRowOpacity(textEls, i); } }
      };
      if (i < rows.length - 1){ cfg.endTrigger = rows[i + 1]; cfg.end = function(){ return 'top ' + line(i + 1) + 'px'; }; }
      else cfg.end = 'bottom top';
      mobileTriggers.push(ScrollTrigger.create(cfg));
    });
  }

  function tweenCaseTo(C, i){
    /* R7 runda 2, fynd 2: remember which row was actually wanted even when
       the measurement below fails (iframe not yet loaded) - the 'load'
       listener reads this to catch the embedded site up to the right row
       the instant it finally can, instead of leaving it frozen at row 0. */
    C.pendingRow = i;
    if (!C.y && !measureCaseSettled(C)) return;
    var target = C.y[i];
    /* R7 runda 2, fynd 2 (andra bugfixen): startade tidigare från C.last,
       som börjar på sentinelvärdet -1. Första någonsin-anropet för en case
       fick då proxy.v = target redan vid skapandet (C.last<0) - en tween
       FRÅN target TILL target. Uppmätt (page.evaluate, en isolerad körning):
       C.last stod kvar på -1 genom alla sex radbyten, vilket bevisar att
       onUpdate aldrig hann skriva ett enda värde innan nästa rad already
       återskapade samma självrefererande nollrörelse - självförstärkande,
       aldrig läkt av sig själv. Att läsa iframens EGEN levande scrollY i
       stället för den cachade C.last är alltid sant (0 vid första anropet,
       vad den faktiskt står i därefter) och kan aldrig fastna i samma fälla. */
    var proxy = { v: C.w ? C.w.scrollY : target };
    gsap.to(proxy, {
      v: target, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power2.out',
      onUpdate: function(){
        if (C.w && Math.abs(proxy.v - C.last) >= 0.5){ C.w.scrollTo({ top: proxy.v, left: 0, behavior: 'instant' }); C.last = proxy.v; }
      }
    });
  }

    Object.keys(CASES).forEach(function(k){
      var C = CASES[k];
      if (C.w) measureCase(C);
    });
  }, { passive: true });

  /* ============================================================ §7b calyx / hōrai showcase copy (was §7) */
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.showcase-head'), function(head){
    var h2 = head.querySelector('h2');
    var fill = seamFill(head, 'inset(0 100% 0 0)');
    if (fill){
      gsap.to(fill, {
        clipPath: 'inset(0 0% 0 0)', duration: 0.7, ease: 'power2.out',

      gsap.to(nameSplit.chars, {

  var prisLead = document.querySelector('.pris-lead');
  var prisA = document.querySelector('.pris-tier-a');
  var prisB = document.querySelector('.pris-tier-b');
  var prisTl = gsap.timeline({

    scrollTrigger: { trigger: '.pris-bento', start: 'top 78%', toggleActions: 'play none none reverse' }

      onComplete: function(){ el.childNodes[0].nodeValue = originalText; }
    });
  }
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.price-value.tnum'), function(el){
    var text = el.childNodes[0] && el.childNodes[0].nodeValue ? el.childNodes[0].nodeValue : '';

  var kontaktAnchor = document.getElementById('kontaktCardAnchor');
  var kontaktTilt = document.getElementById('kontaktCardTilt');
  var kontaktFlip = document.getElementById('kontaktCardFlip');
  var kontaktFront = document.getElementById('kontaktCardFront');
  var kontaktBack = document.getElementById('kontaktCardBack');
  var kontaktFlipped = false;

  if (kontaktFlip){
    gsap.set(kontaktFlip, { rotationY: 0, transformPerspective: 1200 });
    gsap.set(kontaktTilt, { transformStyle: 'preserve-3d' });

    function setKontaktFlip(flipped, opts){
      opts = opts || {};
      if (flipped === kontaktFlipped) return;
      kontaktFlipped = flipped;
      /* R7 (H9): focus on the side that turns away moves to the side that
         turns in, instead of falling to <body> when the front goes inert. */
      var hadFocus = kontaktFront === document.activeElement || kontaktFront.contains(document.activeElement);

      kontaktFront.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(flipped));
      kontaktBack.toggleAttribute('inert', !flipped);
      if (flipped && hadFocus){
        var firstLink = kontaktBack.querySelector('a');
        if (firstLink) firstLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      }
      var dur = opts.immediate ? 0 : 0.7;
      var tl = gsap.timeline();
      tl.to(kontaktFlip, { rotationY: flipped ? 180 : 0, duration: dur, ease: 'power2.inOut' }, 0);
      if (!opts.immediate){
        /* "en kort lyftning" - the card lifts slightly mid-turn, an echo of
           the hero card's own scale-up at the midpoint of its flip. R6 §7:
           desktop only - on a narrow mobile stack the card's own row is
           shallower, and even a small upward lift measurably narrowed the
           gap to the heading above during the sweep test. Rotation alone
           already reads as a flip; the lift is a nice-to-have, not load
           bearing, so it is simplest to drop where the margin is tight. */
        var liftPx = window.innerWidth >= 768 ? -14 : 0;
        if (liftPx) tl.to(kontaktFlip, { y: liftPx, duration: dur * 0.45, ease: 'power2.out', yoyo: true, repeat: 1 }, 0);
      }

    kontaktFront.addEventListener('click', function(){ setKontaktFlip(true); });

    /* hover tilt (desktop only): the card leans toward the pointer in 3D,
       +/-8 deg on each axis, via gsap.quickTo so it eases toward the
       target instead of snapping straight to the raw mouse delta. */
    if (window.matchMedia('(hover: hover)').matches && kontaktAnchor){
      var qTiltY = gsap.quickTo(kontaktTilt, 'rotationY', { duration: 0.4, ease: 'power3.out' });
      var qTiltX = gsap.quickTo(kontaktTilt, 'rotationX', { duration: 0.4, ease: 'power3.out' });
      kontaktAnchor.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e){
        var r = kontaktAnchor.getBoundingClientRect();
        var px = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width - 0.5;
        var py = (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height - 0.5;
        qTiltY(px * 16);
        qTiltX(py * -16);
      });
      kontaktAnchor.addEventListener('mouseleave', function(){ qTiltY(0); qTiltX(0); });
    }

    /* fail toward visible (husregel 10): self-flips at 70% through the
       section's own scroll range. The section is a single 100svh
       quadrant, so this range's math (start:'top bottom', end:'bottom
       bottom') puts progress at ~1 as soon as the section is fully in
       view - a straight jump to #kontakt, or to the page bottom, already
       lands past 0.7 on refresh and shows the back immediately; a normal
       scroll-in crosses 0.7 near the end of its entrance. */
    ScrollTrigger.create({
      trigger: '#kontakt', start: 'top bottom', end: 'bottom bottom',
      onUpdate: function(self){ if (self.progress >= 0.7) setKontaktFlip(true); },
      onRefresh: function(self){ if (self.progress >= 0.7) setKontaktFlip(true, { immediate: true }); }
    });
  }

  var footerMark = document.querySelector('.footer-mark');
  if (footerMark){
    var footerSplit = SplitText.create(footerMark, { type: 'chars', aria: 'hidden' }); /* R7 (H8): decorative wordmark, no aria-label on a <span> */ // lead R4: .footer-cell overflow clips the rise; a per-char mask sliced the X overhang

    gsap.set(footerSplit.chars, { yPercent: 120 });
    /* R4 fix: end:'top 60%' assumed the footer's top could still travel up
       to 60% of the viewport after it appears, but the footer is the last
       element on the page - at 390/768 there isn't enough scroll room
       left for the footer's top to reach that far, so progress stalled
       below 1 at max scroll (chars stuck mid-rise: "AI UNIv"). end:'bottom
       bottom' instead ties progress:1 to the footer's bottom reaching the
       viewport's bottom, which is exactly true max-scroll at every
       breakpoint (the footer is the final element; the page cannot
       scroll further once its bottom is in view). */
    gsap.to(footerSplit.chars, {
      yPercent: 0, ease: 'none', stagger: { each: 0.05, from: 'start' },

     refreshes itself on DOMContentLoaded and load, and fonts.ready (above) asks
     for one more through safeRefresh; each extra pass re-laid the pins and was
     logged as layout shift. */
})();
</script>

</body>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="sv">
<head>

:root{

  --ink:#232323;
  --black:#000000;

  --headline-40:clamp(2.5rem, 1.352rem + 4.9vw, 6.25rem);
  --headline-20:clamp(2rem, 1.694rem + 1.306vw, 3rem);
  --h3:38px;
  --body:16px;
  --body-30:clamp(1.5rem, 1.347rem + 0.653vw, 2rem);
  --caption:13px;
  --cellpad:20px;
}

*{box-sizing:border-box;}
html{color-scheme:light;}
body{
  margin:0;
  background:#000;
  color:var(--ink);
  font-family:"Geist","Arial",system-ui,sans-serif;

  line-height:1.3;

}
img{display:block;max-width:100%;}
.mono{font-family:"Geist Mono","Consolas",monospace;font-weight:400;}
h1,h2,h3,p,ol,ul,figure{margin:0;padding:0;}
a{color:inherit;}
.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0;}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------- rutverket shell */
.rutverk{max-width:1440px;margin:0 auto;background:#000;}
.rutverk > section{scroll-margin-top:48px;}

.g{display:grid;gap:1px;background:#000;}
.cell{background:var(--paper);padding:var(--cellpad);position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.cell--pad0{padding:0;}
.cell--ink{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);}
.cell--black{background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);}
.cell--grey{background:var(--grey);color:var(--ink);}
.cell--mint{background:var(--mint);color:var(--black);}
.cell--rust{background:var(--rust);color:var(--paper);}
.cell--lacquer{background:var(--lacquer);color:var(--paper);}

.g12{grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);}
@media (max-width:1199px){

}

}

.c-2{grid-column:span 2;}
.c-3{grid-column:span 3;}

.c-5{grid-column:span 5;}
.c-6{grid-column:span 6;}

.headline-50{font-size:var(--headline-50);line-height:.8;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-weight:500;}

.h3{font-size:var(--h3);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-weight:500;}
.body{font-size:var(--body);line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.02em;}
.body-30{font-size:var(--body-30);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.02em;}
.caption{font-size:var(--caption);letter-spacing:0;}
.tnum{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- topline */
.topline{

  display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:1px;background:#000;

.topline-mid{background:var(--paper);}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- hero */
/* R3: the fixed 190svh CSS-sticky stage is gone. The pin distance is now
   owned by ScrollTrigger's own pinSpacing (desktop matchMedia branch,

.hero-wrap{position:relative;max-width:1440px;margin:0 auto;}
.hero-stage{

  /* Mobile drops the pin: no extra scroll-span, no sticky stage. The four

.hero-oh{background:var(--grey);}
.hero-nv{background:var(--grey);}
.hero-nh{background:var(--mint);}
.hero-h1{max-width:14ch;}

.dither-layer{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
.color-layer{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}

/* card: a physical object (light stock, ink edge, hard offset shadow) so
   it reads against a black cell instead of disappearing into it. ~1.6x
   the R1 size at 1440 (was ~340px wide, now ~520px), 85:55 kept. */
.card-anchor{

}
.face{

.face--front{background:#fff;padding:6%;}

.card-mark{font-size:clamp(20px,2.6vw,32px);letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0;}
.card-kicker{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(11px,1.1vw,14px);opacity:.65;margin:2px 0 0;}
.card-rule{border:0;border-top:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.25);margin:6px 0;width:100%;}

.process-num{font-family:"Geist Mono";font-weight:400;font-size:13px;padding-top:4px;}
.process-step-title{margin:0 0 6px;}
.process-p{color:#bdbdbd;max-width:56ch;font-size:15px;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- exempelcase */
/* R5 §A bugfix: 0.6x bottom padding (12px) was less than the SplitText
   mask-breathe allowance (0.16em, ~16-20px at this clamp size) needs to
   clear the word's own descenders before the cell's overflow:hidden edge
   - verify_motion.py's legibility scan caught the word's rendered box
   (with its mask wrapper's padding-bottom) genuinely sitting a few px
   below the cell's clip boundary at every scroll position (0vh visible,
   not >=40vh). Matching the top padding removes the clip entirely. */
.case-word-cell{padding:calc(var(--cellpad)*1.4) var(--cellpad) calc(var(--cellpad)*1.4 + 4px);overflow:hidden;}
.case-word-cell .headline-50{max-width:100%;}

/* R5 §B1: väljaren - två knappar, skarpa 1440x900-vyer, ingen beskärande zoom */
.case-picker-cell{padding:0 var(--cellpad) calc(var(--cellpad)*1.2);background:#000;}
.case-picker{display:grid;gap:1px;background:#000;}
.case-choice{
  display:block;width:100%;margin:0;padding:0;border:0;background:var(--paper);color:inherit;
  font:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;
}
.case-choice-frame{position:relative;display:block;aspect-ratio:16/10;overflow:hidden;background:var(--grey);}
.case-choice-frame img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transform:scale(1);transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1);}
@media (hover:hover){
  .case-choice:hover .case-choice-frame img,
  .case-choice:focus-visible .case-choice-frame img{transform:scale(1.04);}
}
.case-choice:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--black);outline-offset:-3px;}
.case-choice-meta{display:block;padding:16px var(--cellpad) 20px;border-bottom:4px solid transparent;}
.case-choice[aria-pressed="true"] .case-choice-meta{border-bottom-color:var(--mint);}
.case-choice-meta .h3{display:block;margin-bottom:4px;font-size:22px;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- showcase (B2/C) */
.showcase-stage{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:1px;background:#000;}
/* R7 (H13): while the stage is more than 1.5 viewports away it is not drawn.
   Every ScrollTrigger refresh measured the pinned stage in a state Chrome
   logged as a 0.947 layout shift (two at load, CLS 1.89) although nothing
   moved on screen; an invisible box is not counted. Toggled by an
   IntersectionObserver in both directions, never while it can be seen. */
.showcase-stage.is-far, .showcase-stage.is-far *{visibility:hidden !important;}
/* H10 (R7): the showcase pins only where its side column fits. Below 561 px of height (768x432 = 200 % zoom) it takes the stacked layout, so no step text is clipped and the wheel never scrolls an inner panel. */
@media (min-width:768px) and (min-height:561px){ .showcase-stage{grid-template-columns:7fr 5fr;} }
.showcase-embed-cell{padding:0;background:var(--paper);position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.showcase-embed-cell .showcase-frame-wrap{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper);}
.showcase-embed-cell .showcase-poster{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;object-position:top center;}
.showcase-embed-cell iframe{
  position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:1440px;height:900px;border:0;background:var(--paper);
  transform-origin:top left;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;
}
@media (max-width:767px), (max-height:560px){
  .showcase-embed-cell{position:sticky;top:48px;height:56svh;z-index:2;}
}
@media (min-width:768px) and (max-height:560px){ .showcase-embed-cell{height:45svh;} }
@media (min-width:768px) and (min-height:561px){
  /* R6 §3, two stacked causes, both fixed here:
     1) .showcase-side's natural content (all 5/6 rows, R5's rise-mask kept
        every body visible at once) was taller than the embed cell's
        explicit height. A CSS grid item with an explicit height does not
        stretch to match a taller sibling's row track - the TRACK grows to
        fit the tall side instead, leaving the embed cell short of the
        row's actual height by the difference (measured ~110px), exposing
        the stage's own black gap background below the frame. Pinning both
        columns to the SAME explicit height (with the side's own
        overflow-y:auto as a never-clip safety net) makes them structurally
        impossible to mismatch, regardless of how much text a future edit
        adds.
     2) That explicit height was `100svh - 48px`, sized to sit BELOW the
        48px sticky topline - but the pin (`start:'top top'`) puts the
        section's rendered top at the viewport's own y:0, with the topline
        merely painted on top of (not offsetting) its first 48px. The
        result: content correctly avoids the topline visually, but then
        runs 48px short of the viewport's bottom edge, showing the stage's
        black background as a trailing band under both columns (measured:
        embed/side bottom at 852 of a 900-tall viewport). Hero's own pin
        has this identical 48px arithmetic and gap - invisible there only
        because it lands on the page's own black background either side.
        Showcase's is visible because there's real content flush above it.
        Fixed the same way hero's is invisible: fill the FULL viewport
        (100svh) - the topline still visually covers the top 48px (it's
        position:sticky, z-index:40, opaque), but the bottom now lands
        exactly on the viewport edge, so no gap is left to expose.

     R7 runda 2, fynd 1: that "topline merely painted on top" claim was
     wrong for `.showcase-head`'s own rubrik - the topline IS opaque and
     DOES cover whatever renders in its first 48px; it just happened not to
     matter for hero (dark ground either side). Here `.showcase-head`'s
     headline-40 sits flush at the pinned section's very top edge, so its
     cap-height rendered UNDER the topline and got visually sheared (lead's
     through-05..through-12, 2026-09-25). Fix: pin the section 48px lower
     instead of hiding 48px under an opaque bar - `start:'top top+=48'` on
     the ScrollTrigger (setupDesktopEngine) puts the section's rendered top
     at y:48, exactly below the topline, and both cell heights shrink by
     the same 48px so the bottom still lands flush on the viewport edge -
     the R6 §3 gap this block fixed doesn't reopen, because now BOTH the
     offset and the height account for the topline, not just the height. */
  .showcase-embed-cell{height:calc(100svh - 48px);}
  .showcase-side{height:calc(100svh - 48px);overflow-y:auto;}
}
.showcase-side{display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr;gap:1px;background:#000;}
.showcase-panel{display:contents;}
.showcase-head{padding:calc(var(--cellpad)*1.4) var(--cellpad);color:var(--paper);}
/* H7: the frames are inert previews; the site itself opens from here */
.showcase-open{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:32px;margin-top:10px;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:-.01em;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;}
.showcase-open:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--paper);outline-offset:2px;}
.showcase-head .headline-40{margin-bottom:8px;}

/* R7 §C: the accordion ledger (R6 §1/§2) is replaced on desktop by a single
   crossfading box - one background for the whole "ruta", every step
   grid-stacked in one cell and GSAP-scrubbed by the showcase pin's onUpdate
   (never a class-toggle). Mobile keeps R6's stacked-rows layout unchanged;
   only its opacity mechanism changes (measured contrast fix, see below). */
.showcase-row{padding:var(--cellpad);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;}
.showcase-row h3{margin-bottom:0;}
.showcase-row p{max-width:52ch;font-size:15px;margin-top:8px;}

@media (min-width:768px) and (min-height:561px){
  /* R6 runda 6 (F-019/F-022): tre celler i sidans eget rutverk (gap:1px,
     background:#000 skiner igenom som fog, varje cell sin egen bakgrund) -
     räknarcellen (auto), textcellen (auto, satt av det längsta stegets
     höjd via samma grid-area:1/1-stapling som förut) och en ny detaljcell
     (1fr, fyller resten) som visar en bild ur den valda sajten per steg.
     Den lodräta stegskalan (R3-R4) är borttagen helt - Anton (F-022):
     "Det ser ut som något ofärdigt". Tom yta löses nu med riktigt innehåll
     (en bild ur arbetet), inte med ett dekorativt streck. */
  .showcase-rows{display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto auto 1fr;gap:1px;background:#000;height:100%;}
  .showcase-panel--calyx .showcase-box-head,
  .showcase-panel--calyx .showcase-steps{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);}
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-box-head,
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-steps{background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);}
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-row p{color:#bdbdbd;}
  /* räknarcellen: NN/NN överst, mintspåret under - som R3, innan R4 flyttade
     räknaren ned i den nu borttagna skalan. */
  .showcase-box-head{padding:var(--cellpad);}
  .showcase-counter{display:block;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .showcase-track{position:relative;height:4px;}
  .showcase-track::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;left:0;right:0;height:1px;background:#000;transform:translateY(-50%);}
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-track::before{background:var(--paper);opacity:.3;}
  .showcase-track-fill{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:4px;background:var(--mint);transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(0);}
  .showcase-steps{display:grid;}
  /* R3 §4 (F-019): rubriken får aldrig ta över - sajten är huvudsaken,
     rutan är bildtexten. h3 tillbaka i rubrikskala (30px), inte
     headline-40-tokenet R2 lånade; jättesiffran är borttagen. */
  /* R6b: toppjusterad. Centrerad (basregeln) satte stegrubriken 14 px lägre i
     steg med tre rader än i steg med fyra, så rubriken hoppade vid varje byte. */
  .showcase-row{grid-area:1/1;padding:0 var(--cellpad) calc(var(--cellpad)*1.4);justify-content:flex-start;}
  .showcase-row h3{font-size:30px;line-height:1.15;font-weight:500;}
  .showcase-row p{font-size:18px;line-height:1.5;max-width:40ch;}
  /* detaljcellen: en <figure> per steg, grid-stackad (samma grid-area:1/1-
     teknik som .showcase-row ovan), färglager under och ett dither-rutnät
     ovanpå (buildTileGrid, samma mekanism som #kontakt/tes-bilden) som
     löses upp i den skrubbade pin-tidslinjen (C.tl, se buildStepTimelines).
     Calyx grå grund (dither svart-på-grått), Hōrai svart grund (dither
     vitt-på-svart) - samma två grundfärger dither.py redan producerar. */
  /* R6b: bilden är ett förstoringsglas (2,5-3x iframen) tagen i exakt cellens
     proportion vid 1440x900 (599,6/426,5 = 1,4058). Vid andra fönster varierar
     cellen från 0,63 (2560x1440) till 1,59 (1280x800); figuren låses därför
     till bildens proportion och passas in (contain) med container-enheter, så
     att färglagret och rutnätet ovanpå alltid täcker samma yta. Med cover
     klipptes luppen (adressen, priset) och rutorna gled ur linje mot färgen. */
  .showcase-detail{position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:0;container-type:size;}
  .showcase-panel--calyx .showcase-detail{background:var(--grey);}
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-detail{background:var(--black);}
  .showcase-figure{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;translate:-50% -50%;width:min(100cqw,140.58cqh);height:min(100cqh,71.13cqw);margin:0;opacity:0;}
  .showcase-figure:first-child{opacity:1;}
  .showcase-figure img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:fill;}
}
@media (max-width:767px), (max-height:560px){
  /* R7 runda 2, fynd 2: .showcase-embed-cell (position:sticky) satt över
     .showcase-side (head + rader) i normalt dokumentflöde, så när huvudet
     ("Hōrai") rullade upp genom den redan-klistrade ramen (z-index:2) klipptes
     det mot ramens underkant (lead: through-02/03). Huvudet ska stå helt
     synligt INNAN raderna - och innan ramen - börjar klistra, så .showcase-side
     görs display:contents här (bara mobil) för att lyfta .showcase-head och
     .showcase-rows till .showcase-stage's egna grid-items, och ordnas om med
     `order`: huvud (1) -> ram (2, där klistringen börjar) -> rader (3). */
  .showcase-side{display:contents;}
  .showcase-head{order:1;}
  .showcase-embed-cell{order:2;}
  .showcase-rows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px;background:#000;order:3;}
  /* R6 runda 6: .showcase-box-head hålls INTE display:none längre. Mätt
     (shots/r6-mobile-before, före denna runda): den borttagna stegskalan
     (.showcase-scale) hade ALDRIG en egen mobilregel, så dess räknartext
     redan föll igenom osynligt formaterad, som en enkel textrad i
     .showcase-rows egen svarta gap-bakgrund, ovanpå .showcase-embed-cell.
     Räknaren (nu flyttad hit) måste fortsätta synas EXAKT så - briefen
     ("mobil oförändrad") gäller även denna oavsiktliga men redan existerande
     synlighet. .showcase-track har fortfarande ingen mobilstorlek (dess
     height/position-regler ligger kvar i 768px-blocket ovan) och kollapsar
     därför osynligt till 0px, precis som förut. */
  .showcase-detail{display:none;}
  .showcase-steps{display:contents;}
  .showcase-panel--calyx .showcase-row:nth-child(odd){background:var(--paper);}
  .showcase-panel--calyx .showcase-row:nth-child(even){background:var(--grey);}
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-row:nth-child(odd){background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);}
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-row:nth-child(odd) p{color:#bdbdbd;}
  .showcase-panel--horai .showcase-row:nth-child(even){background:var(--grey);}
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- pris */
.pris-statement{padding:calc(var(--cellpad)*2) var(--cellpad);}
.pris-statement .body-30{max-width:60ch;margin-top:16px;font-weight:500;}
/* All placement lives in these classes (not inline styles) so the media
   queries below can actually win the cascade at each breakpoint. */
.pris-bento{grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);grid-template-rows:auto auto;}
.pris-lead{grid-column:1 / span 6;grid-row:1 / span 2;background:var(--mint);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;}
.pris-tier{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;min-height:220px;}
.pris-tier-a{grid-column:7 / span 6;grid-row:1;background:var(--paper);}
.pris-tier-b{grid-column:7 / span 6;grid-row:2;background:var(--grey);}
@media (max-width:1199px){
  .pris-bento{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .pris-lead{grid-column:1 / span 2;grid-row:1;}
  .pris-tier-a{grid-column:1;grid-row:2;}
  .pris-tier-b{grid-column:2;grid-row:2;}
}
@media (max-width:767px){
  .pris-bento{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .pris-lead,.pris-tier-a,.pris-tier-b{grid-column:1;grid-row:auto;min-height:0;}
}
.price-label{max-width:34ch;font-size:15px;}
.price-value{font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,44px);letter-spacing:-.03em;}
.price-value .unit{font-size:.5em;margin-left:2px;}
.price-value--text{font-size:clamp(18px,2vw,24px);}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- kontakt (R5 §C: heron speglad) */
.kontakt-quad{
  position:relative;display:grid;gap:1px;background:#000;min-height:100svh;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:1fr 1fr;
  grid-template-areas:"ov oh" "nv nh";
}
.kontakt-q{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:var(--cellpad);}
.kontakt-q--ov{grid-area:ov;background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;}
/* R6 §4: headline-40 is tuned for a single "jätteord" (hero, case names) -
   at this cell's half-page width, a four-word sentence in it ran past the
   ÖV/ÖH seam (measured x>720 at 1440, into the card's own space). A
   smaller, dedicated clamp - same family as the old kontakt-giant's - fits
   three lines comfortably inside the cell at 1440/1280/768, verified with
   getBoundingClientRect against the cell box, not eyeballed. */
.kontakt-q--ov h2{
  font-size:clamp(1.75rem, 1.1rem + 2.6vw, 3.4rem);line-height:1.05;
  letter-spacing:-.03em;font-weight:500;max-width:12ch;
}
.kontakt-q--ov p{max-width:32ch;font-size:15px;}
.kontakt-q--oh{grid-area:oh;background:var(--paper);}
.kontakt-q--nv{grid-area:nv;background:var(--grey);padding:0;}
.kontakt-q--nh{grid-area:nh;background:var(--mint);}
@media (max-width:767px){
  /* R6 §7: nh gets more room than ov/nv (was the same minmax(60vw) as
     both) - a 3D Y-axis rotation's perspective projection genuinely bulges
     a flat card's rendered bounding box taller at the near edge as it
     turns (measured: +/-28px top/bottom at 1200px perspective, still
     +/-24px at 3000px - foreshortening a rotated rectangle really does
     grow its axis-aligned bbox, not a rounding artefact), and centring an
     88%-wide card in a 60vw-tall row left only ~27px clearance to the
     subline above - not enough to survive that bulge at any angle in the
     0-180deg sweep. */
  .kontakt-quad{grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:minmax(60vw,auto) minmax(76vw,auto) minmax(60vw,auto);grid-template-areas:"ov" "nh" "nv";min-height:auto;}
  .kontakt-q--oh{display:none;}
}

/* the card sits on the crossing of all four quadrants (a grid item that
   spans the full 2x2 and centres itself), mirroring heron's own card. On
   mobile it drops into the mint cell's own grid area instead, 88% wide. */
/* R6 §4/§7: centred on the FULL 2x2 crossing put the card's top edge only
   ~15-50px below the headline row at rest, with zero margin for the flip's
   lift or the hover-tilt's foreshortening - both could (and did, measured)
   bring the card within single-digit px of "verksamhet.". Spanning only
   the LOWER row (grid-row:2, still centred horizontally on the vertical
   seam = still "on the crossing") puts the card inside the NV/NH half
   entirely, with a full row-height of clearance above it before ÖV even
   starts. */
.kontakt-card-anchor{
  grid-column:1 / 3;grid-row:2;place-self:center;z-index:5;
  width:clamp(300px,32vw,460px);aspect-ratio:85/55;perspective:1200px;
}
@media (max-width:767px){
  .kontakt-card-anchor{grid-area:nh;place-self:center;width:80%;}
}
.kontakt-card-tilt{width:100%;height:100%;position:relative;transform-style:preserve-3d;}
.card-flip2{width:100%;height:100%;position:relative;transform-style:preserve-3d;box-shadow:10px 10px 0 0 #000;}
.card-flip2 button.face{margin:0;padding:6%;font:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;display:block;width:100%;height:100%;}
/* R7 (H9, 1.4.11): black ring, 3:1+ on mint, grey and the white stock alike.
   The back has no full-face flip button any more: a tap beside a link does
   nothing, and the links sit inside the face so their ring is never clipped. */
.card-flip2 button.face:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--black);outline-offset:3px;}
.card-back-content{position:relative;z-index:1;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:10px;}
.card-back-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;column-gap:clamp(12px,1.6vw,22px);}
.card-back-links a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;font-size:clamp(13px,1.5vw,18px);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;}
.card-back-links a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--black);outline-offset:2px;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- footer */
.footer-cell{background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);padding:0 0 0 var(--cellpad);height:34vw;max-height:340px;min-height:200px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;overflow:hidden;}
.footer-mark{font-size:clamp(80px,16vw,220px);line-height:.8;letter-spacing:-.04em;white-space:nowrap;padding-bottom:.06em;}
.footer-strip{padding:18px var(--cellpad);background:var(--black);color:var(--paper);}
.footer-strip p{font-size:14px;}
.footer-strip a{text-decoration:underline;white-space:nowrap;}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- resolve (dither -> color) */
.img-cell{position:relative;}
/* R3: §3 dither -> colour grid-stagger. The tile grid sits over the
   already-visible colour layer; each tile shows one slice of the dither
   image and fades on its own random-order schedule, so the resolve reads
   as pixels dissolving away rather than a wipe. Built once at init from
   the existing .dither-layer <img> (see buildTileGrid in the script). */
.tile-grid{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;pointer-events:none;}
.tile-grid > span{display:block;background-repeat:no-repeat;}
.is-resolving > .tile-grid > span{will-change:opacity;}
.color-layer{clip-path:none;}

/* R3: seam-anchored decorations, all created/positioned by the script. */
.seam-line{position:absolute;background:var(--mint);pointer-events:none;z-index:3;}
/* the crosshair seam-draw is a 2x2-grid flourish; hero-stage stacks to one
   column under 768px (see .hero-stage media query above), so the same
   absolute-positioned lines would otherwise bisect the whole stacked
   column top to bottom - hide them there. */
@media (max-width:767px){ .seam-line{display:none;} }
.process-row{position:relative;}
.process-progress{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:var(--mint);transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:top center;pointer-events:none;z-index:6;}
/* process-left/process-right only sit side by side at the 1200px+ 12-col
   grid (BYGGSPEC .g12 breakpoints); below that they stack, so the seam
   the progress line marks no longer exists - hide it rather than let a
   stale left-offset poke 2px past the right edge (390/768 overflow). */
@media (max-width:1199px){ .process-progress{display:none;} }

/* R3: SplitText's own mask:'lines'/'words'/'chars' option wraps each split
   unit in its own clipping span, and every heading that gets split already
   sits inside a .cell (overflow:hidden) or .footer-cell (overflow:hidden)
   — so no extra clip rule is needed on the headings themselves (adding one
   risked cutting descenders that round 2's static layout already relies
   on fitting without it). */

/* spacing rhythm between section groups */
.rhythm{height:110px;}
@media (max-width:767px){ .rhythm{height:72px;} }
</style>
</head>

  <section id="process">

      <div class="c-6 cell process-left">
        <div class="process-sticky">
          <p class="process-kicker mono">Vår process:</p>
          <h2 class="process-title headline-40">Från samtal till lanserad sida.</h2>
          <p class="process-lock body">Webbdesign, design och system. Allt på ett ställe.</p>
          <div class="process-image img-cell" data-resolve="process" style="background:var(--grey)">
            <img class="dither-layer" src="assets/dither/k4-cabin-desk-dither-grey.webp" alt="" loading="lazy">

          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="c-6 cell cell--pad0 process-right">
        <ol class="process-steps">
          <li class="process-row-item">
            <span class="process-num mono" aria-hidden="true">01</span>
            <div><h3 class="process-step-title h3">Uppstart</h3>
              <p class="process-p">Vi börjar med ett samtal om er verksamhet samt vad ni vill att sidan ska göra för er. Utifrån det skapar vi ett initialt underlag som ni rättar innan det går till ritbordet.</p></div>
          </li>
          <li class="process-row-item">
            <span class="process-num mono" aria-hidden="true">02</span>
            <div><h3 class="process-step-title h3">Planering</h3>
              <p class="process-p">Vi ritar strukturen som en skiss innan vi formger något. Där ser ni vilka sidor som behövs och vad varje sida ska få besökaren att göra, mobilen först.</p></div>
          </li>
          <li class="process-row-item">
            <span class="process-num mono" aria-hidden="true">03</span>
            <div><h3 class="process-step-title h3">Design</h3>
              <p class="process-p">När strukturen står formger vi sidan efter er verksamhet. Förslaget lägger vi på en testadress, där ni ser det på er egen telefon och säger till innan det går till bygge.</p></div>
          </li>
          <li class="process-row-item">
            <span class="process-num mono" aria-hidden="true">04</span>
            <div><h3 class="process-step-title h3">Utveckling</h3>
              <p class="process-p">Vi bygger sidan i kod från grunden, utan färdig mall, så att den laddar snabbt. Texter och bilder ändrar ni själva, och vill ni lägga till mer bygger ni vidare på det vi lämnat.</p></div>
          </li>
          <li class="process-row-item">
            <span class="process-num mono" aria-hidden="true">05</span>
            <div><h3 class="process-step-title h3">Innehåll</h3>
              <p class="process-p">Ni behöver inte ha något färdigt. Det ni har bearbetar vi, bygger vidare på och kompletterar där något saknas. Texten skriver vi åt er, om ni inte vill ha er egen.</p></div>
          </li>
          <li class="process-row-item">
            <span class="process-num mono" aria-hidden="true">06</span>
            <div><h3 class="process-step-title h3">Lansering</h3>
              <p class="process-p">Innan sidan publiceras går vi igenom varje länk, formulär och bild. Vi testar den med tangentbord och skärmläsare, på telefon och på dator, och visar er hur ni ändrar innehållet själva.</p></div>
          </li>
          <li class="process-row-item">
            <span class="process-num mono" aria-hidden="true">07</span>
            <div><h3 class="process-step-title h3">Förvaltning</h3>
              <p class="process-p">Vi finns kvar efter lansering. Nya sidor och ändringar går samma väg som bygget, så ni ser dem på testadressen innan era kunder gör det. Har ni en fråga mejlar ni oss på kontakt@alunix.se.</p></div>
          </li>
        </ol>
      </div>
    </div>

<script src="assets/vendor/gsap.min.js"></script>
